fileStructure.purpose: Global styling sheet containing Tailwind CSS directives and base styles.
responsibilities: Import Tailwind CSS core layers

fileStructure.purpose: Application entry point that mounts the App component to the DOM.
responsibilities: Bootstrap React application
Render root App component inside StrictMode

fileStructure.purpose: Root application component wrapping the Dashboard page with the ExpenseProvider state context.
responsibilities: Provide global state context to the dashboard
Render the main Dashboard page structure

fileStructure.purpose: Manages global transactions state, filters, and computed balance, income, and expense values.
responsibilities: Own and manage the list of transactions in local storage
Compute derived values: total balance, total income, total expenses
Filter transactions list based on active category selection
Expose functions to add and delete transactions

fileStructure.purpose: Main layout component arranging the balance cards, filters, forms, and transaction lists in a responsive grid.
responsibilities: Layout structure for desktop and mobile screen sizes
Coordinate child components in a cohesive dashboard UI

fileStructure.purpose: Displays current net balance, total incoming funds, and total outgoing expenses with visual indicators.
responsibilities: Render total calculated balance
Render total calculated income
Render total calculated expenses

fileStructure.purpose: Interactive form to input transaction details: description, amount, type (income or expense), and category.
responsibilities: Capture user inputs for new transactions
Validate input fields to prevent empty submissions or zero values
Dispatches transaction addition payload to the context state

fileStructure.purpose: Provides interactive buttons or dropdown options to filter the transaction list by custom categories.
responsibilities: Render category selection buttons or select element
Dispatch selected category filters to the context state

fileStructure.purpose: Displays a list of filtered transactions with category tags, colored amounts based on type, and deletion controls.
responsibilities: Render filtered transactions
Render fallback empty states when no transactions match the filter
Provide interactive delete action for each individual item
